rubric.thesis: Does blurb + intent + artifacts land the sequence's truth statement? 0=off, 5=lands
rubric.helper: Hub present? Close-body text? Readable cues? 0=bare grid, 5=full
rubric.aesthetic: Substrate/biome applied and appropriate to sequence stage? 0=grey, 5=full
